<think>
The compilation failure arises because Struts 2 moved StrutsPrepareAndExecuteFilter from org.apache.struts2.dispatcher.ng.filter to org.apache.struts2.dispatcher.filter in version 2.5.x. The client code imports the old package, causing a missing package error and subsequent unresolved symbol errors for the filter class. The class is still available with the same name and a default constructor; only the package changed. The minimal fix is to update the import to the new package. No other code changes are necessary since the usage with Guice’s ServletModule (binding and filter through the class literal) remains valid.
</think>
